study_strategy.warning: Do not key these by bract color alone. Current Kew treats former C. purpurea var. lindheimeri as accepted species C. lindheimeri.

quick_split: C. indivisa — annual Texas paintbrush, usually compact with vivid scarlet-orange bracts.
C. purpurea — perennial prairie paintbrush with variable bract color; rocky calcareous prairie.
C. lindheimeri — perennial Edwards Plateau endemic; upper leaves commonly 2–3-lobed, orange-red bracts, glandular inflorescence.
